data.overview: Fleurance Nature is a French maker of organic-certified food supplements and cosmetics, based in Fleurance (Gers) and operating since 1972. The brand emphasises organic certification, French manufacturing, eco-conscious packaging and fair-trade sourcing, and holds Fair for Life / For Life certification (first certified 2013, last 2025) as a fair trade partner and brand holder. Independent user-review aggregators note gentle, moisturising products but flag fragrance-preference variability, occasional irritation and a high price point.

claims.claim: Fleurance Nature says its packaging uses vegetable inks on FSC-certified paper and environmentally friendly PET bottles.
claims.quote: Our packaging and communication materials are printed with vegetable inks on paper and cardboard from FSC-certified sustainably managed forests

claims.claim: Fleurance Nature says its scientific team formulates natural and organic products that are both effective and safe under French and European regulations.
claims.quote: the team aims to formulate natural and organic products that are both effective and safe, in accordance with French and European regulations

claims.claim: Fleurance Nature says fair trade is central to its ethical approach, with three Fair for Life certified supply chains.
claims.quote: Fair trade is at the very heart of the Fleurance Nature ethical approach... We currently have 3 FFL (Fair for life, fair trade) chains.

claims.claim: Fleurance Nature states its products are not tested on animals.
claims.quote: Nos produits sont garantis sans : Parabène Phénoxyéthanol Silicones Pesticides de synthèse Phtalates PEG, PPG Antibiotiques Hormones de croissance Irradiation OGM Non testé sur les animaux

papers.title: Fleurance Nature – Fair for Life certified partner
papers.summary: The Fair for Life certifier lists Fleurance Nature (Fleurance, France) as a certified partner under its Fair for Life and For Life programs, first certified in 2013 with the most recent certification dated 2025-10-13. Fleurance Nature is recognised as a Fair Trade Partner for the Argan supply chain and as a Brand Holder marketing Fair for Life-certified products.

findings.text: Fleurance Nature has been continuously certified under Fair for Life and For Life since 2013, most recently in October 2025.
findings.quote: Certification programs : Fair for Life, For Life Brand : Fleurance Nature Location : Fleurance, FR Certified partner : Fair for Life Certification dates : First : 2013 Last : 2025-10-13

findings.text: Fleurance Nature acts as a Fair Trade Partner for the Argan supply chain, undertaking to guarantee a fair price and contribute to a development fund.
findings.quote: it undertakes to guarantee a fair price, to contribute to the development fund and to respect forecast purchase volumes... I act as a Fair Trade Partner for the following supply chain(s): Argan

papers.title: All Fleurance nature Products Ranked by User Reviews
papers.summary: This review aggregator ranks 55 Fleurance Nature products with an average rating of 3.75 across 85 reviews. Users praise gentle, natural-derived ingredients and moisturising creams, but report significant fragrance-preference differences, occasional skin irritation or dryness (notably from micellar water and aloe vera gel), and a frequently mentioned high price point. It notes the brand opposes animal testing and holds Cosmébio/ECOCERT organic certification.

findings.text: Fleurance Nature products average 3.75 across 85 reviews, praised for moisturising power but criticised on fragrance and price.
findings.quote: there are significant individual differences in fragrance preferences, and the functionality and price of some products should be considered

findings.text: Some products reportedly caused skin irritation or dryness despite the brand's gentle positioning.
findings.quote: some micellar water and aloe vera gel products reported skin irritation or dryness. The high price point is also frequently mentioned as a drawback

findings.text: The aggregator states the brand adheres to avoiding harmful ingredients and opposes animal testing.
findings.quote: adhering to principles of avoiding harmful ingredients (silicone, SLS, phenoxyethanol, parabens, dyes, synthetic fragrances, etc.) and opposing animal testing
